items.name: KRAPI · AI Trading Agent Workshop
items.label: W45 · Nov 5 – Nov 11, 2026
items.headline: Bring a laptop, leave with your own trading dashboard.
points: Hands-on week 2 of KRAPI's AI Trading Agent Build Workshop — Sat, Nov 7, 6:30–10 pm KST, Gangnam, Seoul (in person, run in Korean).
Issue and connect exchange API keys, then build a personal dashboard for balances and positions.
Bring a laptop; snacks and drinks provided. Entry by host approval on Luma.
Tip: create keys with withdrawals off and an IP allow-list.

items.name: MIURO.AI
items.label: W44 · Oct 29 – Nov 4, 2026
items.headline: AI-made songs, turned into works you can own and license.
points: GM-1, an in-house music foundation model: lyrics, vocals, melody and arrangement in one system, strongest in Mandarin.
Miuro Claw, a conversational agent that takes a track from prompt to stems to release.
Each release gets a work identity, a version record and a licence scope; the chain handles ownership and settlement.
Working with Pudgy Penguins on Pudgy Beats, with rewards tied to creation rather than to a node.
